hold: The family decided on 2026-09-14 to keep the VN-0157 photograph public but hold the story of the injury off the site for now (the #22 sensitivity decision). His words are unchanged; delete this hold when the family decides to show it.
researchNotes: A revision of his own account. On 2026-09-05, at VN-0157, he said the blasting cap that injured the Cambodian striker was one he had dropped (giscus-vn-0157-c18308344). On 2026-09-12 he says it may not have been: the Cambodian found one, and he does not know where it came from. The same day his son wrote the same point in his own words on the VN-0157 page (giscus-vn-0157-c18415150, paraphrase). Both accounts are his and both are kept; neither corrects the other. What happened to the man afterwards is unchanged in both. Ledger #33, issue #129; the decision about showing the photograph publicly (#22) remains the family's.
